newsitem.title: USA: New West Q4 same-store sales rise 7.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: New West Q4 same-store sales rise 7.1 pct.

text.p: New West Eyeworks Inc, a retailer of glasses and contact lenses, on Monday said severe weather in the northwestern United States hurt total sales in the final weeks of December, holding quarterly same store sales gaines to 7.1 percent over the year ago period.
Through October and November, sames store sales had been up as much as 13.4 percent, the company said in a statement.
About 81 of its 146 total retail stores either closed or were "severely impacted" by flooding and heavy rainfall, leading to estimated lost sales of over $500,000.
Physical damage to the stores was "minimal," it said.
